name: smwmusic-soul-blazer-world-of-demons
title: Soul Blazer - World of Demons
description:
A multi-purpose song that's mysterious and atmospheric. Can fit any unsettling place like castles, ruins, ghost houses, factories, or really any of your weird contest levels.

This song really hit something in me at my first playthrough of Soul Blazer.

This update was made using NintSpc and promoted during Winter 2022 C3.
